verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents its own headless interfaces: a management API for automating workflows over datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs and API keys, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and the honeymarker CLI for scriptable marker CRUD. Nothing documents CI pipeline usage, and the CLI covers only markers. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance or examples (e.g. pipeline integrations), a general-purpose CLI beyond markers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Build integrations and automate workflows with the Honeycomb API.
Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
a lightweight marker management tool that provides a CRUD command line interface
You can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling.
